Plenty of sweet treats as well, including gluten free and egg free options. Jef's Cafe also hosts various music nights, and lots of local art can be found throughout the cafe.

I've stopped here for a Donair a few times. The prices are close to other Donair places but I find the portions aren't as big as other places. It's a smaller family ran business so the people working there are nice. I know of a lot of people whole just love these Donairs and actually go out of their way to drive to Beaumont to have a Donair here! They got a TV there so you can sit and relax while eating if that's your thing. I know a few times they have forgotten items I bought.. Like fries or a can of pop.. And I didn't realize until I got home (my bad). But otherwise if you enjoy Donairs and are in or around Beaumont area you just have to stop and try one of these Donairs. It's worth a shot! :D
Friendly staff, great coffee, homemade hot soup and sandwich for a good price. Local art and comfortable surroundings.

One star for the great food and one for the great workers/owners. Otherwise the hours are ridiculous!!!! The worst business hours I have ever seen. They close whenever they feel like it and on top of that the regular business hours are sooo stupid that they are wasting a business space that could be made useful. I don't even know how they make money they are barely EVER open!!!!

Donairs was good, and the service was great! Parking was a little confusing, in front of the place the sign says "unauthorized vehicles will be towed". We parked there anyways and we didn't get towed.

Decent donair, which is to say that I have had better and much worse.  Prices are fair but the staff is great.   Portions are a little small but not unfair.   Interior is inviting and has a good selection of oilers memorabilia if you are into that (my condolences). Decent place to eat given the limited selection in town.

The best chicken donair Edmonton and area. Get it with the garlic sauce... so good. Only down side - no green peppers. Other than that, a little high on the price side, but the flavor... again. So good.

I'll wander down to Maina's once every couple of months or so. I'm a big donair/shwarma fan, so I like to think I have a solid idea of what I like. First off, Maina and her staff are top notch. She always greets you with a smile and genuinely cares about the food that she prepares for you. The prices are fair and the portions are comparable to other donair shops in the region. The garlic sauce is also a great addition to any donair.

While it's not the greatest donair shop I have ever been to in my life, it's also a great locally owned business here in Beaumont that I like to support. They provide a really good product and great customer service. if you are ever in Beaumont, you won't be disappointed.
Best donairs, ever! Always pleasant too! I just with that the guy who patrolled the parking lot would stop giving everyone the evil eye!

Beaumont has a well kept secret called Jef's Café and I may be visiting Beaumont more frequently now that I've tried it. The first pleasant surprise was the location. It's on the west side of the main road through town and very close to the big church on the hill. Jef's is easy to find and you can park on the street right in front of the café for free.  The café is bright and has several tables of different sizes.  You walk up to the counter and the menu is up on the wall.   I ordered a Reuben Sandwich and brewed coffee .   The coffee was delicious and well above average for a café.   Their menu said a refill is $1.60 but perhaps it's free if you order a sandwich because she brought me a refill without my even asking for one.  I was glad because one just wasn't enough.  My Reuben took a while but that's because they made it from scratch and hand made takes longer than fast food from a microwave. I would say that it has tied for the best Reuben in greater Edmonton.  There was lots of sauerkraut which is just the way I like it. The price was very reasonable at $8.95.  Really the only thing I can complain about is that the WiFi was not working.  I'm sure that was a temporary problem as they do have guest WiFi.  I didn't try anything from the pastrie counter but there were lots of tasty looking treats in there.  You can be certain that I'll be returning to Jef's Café very soon and I recommend that you try it as well.

Went here for lunch and got the roast beef sandwich. I really liked the way they gave me a sheet to fill out my sandwich order for what type of bread I wanted, spread, filling, cheese and any extras. This made it so simple and I got exactly what I wanted. The staff are lovely and cheerful. The decor is beautiful, I love all the quirky added touches that make this cafe very personable and give it character. The whole restaurant looks very clean, the bathrooms are clean and smell fresh. Definitely recommend everyone to stop in here for a coffee and pastry or for lunch.
Nice little local coffee shop. Lovely summer patio and lots of indoor seating. Good selection of breakfast items, soup, sandwiches, baked goods&drinks.

Stopped in for lunch on our way through Beaumont. Went out of our way to find a locally owned (not a chain) to support.  We don't mind paying extra to support local however in return we expect to have a decent meal.  We each ordered a soup and sandwich, which took nearly 30 min to get, and there was only 1 order in front of us. 

The Cowboy sandwich had 1 tiny piece of thin sliced roast beef, not enough to cover half of the bread.  The grilled cheese sandwich barely had any cheese in it, I actually opened it up to see if they forgot to put cheese in the grilled cheese.  We were both terribly disappointed in the sandwiches.  Top shelf prices for cheap sandwiches with hardly anything in them. I would have been embarrassed to serve that to customers.

Worse than the sandwiches was the soup. It was the smallest 'cup' of soup I have ever seen, and it was $5.  I make pickle soup and have had it in a few restaurants, the pickle soup at Jef's Cafe was the absolute worst attempt at pickle soup, so terrible I didn't eat it.  There was no dill, cream or potato in the soup, just a shredded sour mess. They should be embarrassed so serve slop like that.  The cook should read a pickle soup recipe before they try to serve that again. 

I'm not sure how they remain in business serving food like that. The only positive thing I can say is the latte is good.

Addicted to this place!! 

amazing Donairs
Amazing sweet sauce 
Amazing fries!!!

The people who work there are very nice and friendly

Solid Donair.
Very friendly and genuine staff and owner.
Bright and homey, one of a kind shop.
I've almost hit 30 donair shops now...
Finally made it out to Beaumont to check out the only Donair shop in town.
The bright, friendly, history laden shop is clearly the owners passion.
Very clean.
Very friendly and inviting.
Fits in with the smaller size town feeling of Beaumont.
I had a Jumbo donair with sweet sauce (which is sold at counter by the bottle) and a cup of garlic sauce on the side ($0.50 extra).
Service...very friendly.
Atmosphere...bright and homey.
Meat...a little thin (so less juicy) but well seasoned.
Pita...fresh and soft.
Veggies....fresh.
Sweet sauce...alas...as they made it...there just wasn't enough on my donair to give it a fair shake. I would deffinitely ask for extra or a cup.
Garlic sauce...wuite good.
Value...fair.
All in all...solid.
Bot the best...far from the worst.
If it was the only shop in town...which it is...I could work with her to make it "mine".

Solid donair, the steaming of the meat, pita and cheese is nice.  They do use a premise Meade and sauce so not all homemade, but still the taste was great. Very spicy seasoned meat!

Super clean and friendly.
